mapper.select: WITH R1 AS (SELECT D.FINPROD_ID AS assetId, A.FINPROD_NAME AS assetName, C.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, C.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, NVL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2) as finprodType2, F.TYPE_9 AS type9, F.TYPE_10 AS type10, F.TYPE_11 AS type11, F.TYPE_12 AS type12, SUM(CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN NVL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0)*100 ELSE NVL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0) END ) AS shareAmt, SUM(NVL(D.DSC_COST_AMT, 0) + NVL(D.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0)) AS netAssetValue FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION D /*组合资产估值*/ left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A /*标的类金融产品*/ ON D.FINPROD_ID=A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO C /*组合*/ ON D.PORTFOLIO_ID= C.PORTFOLIO_ID AND to_char(D.CDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{endDate} AND D.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT E /*交易类金融产品*/ ON E.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND E.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE F /*金融产品分类表*/ ON F.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY D.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_NAME , C.PORTFOLIO_ID , C.PORTFOLIO_NAME , NVL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2), F.TYPE_9, F.TYPE_10, F.TYPE_11, F.TYPE_12) SELECT A.*, B.portfolioShare FROM R1 A JOIN ( SELECT SUM(shareAmt ) AS portfolioShare,portfolioId FROM R1 GROUP BY portfolioId ) B ON A.portfolioId=B.portfolioId

SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID ,A.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,D.FINPROD_ID ,0 as BRANCH ,C.FINPROD_TYPE2 ,C.PROFIT_TYPE ,C.VDATE ,B.DEAL_MODE ,to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') as startDate FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID=B.PORTFOLIO_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT(FINPROD_ID) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD) D ON D.FINPROD_ID=A.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE 1=1
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId}

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN temp.bonds*100 ELSE temp.bonds END AS bonds ,temp.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL ,temp.costAmt FROM (SELECT sum(DSC_COST_AMT_B) AS TDY_FLOAT_INGPL ,SUM(DSC_COST_AMT_B) AS costAmt ,SUM(SHARE_AMT) AS bonds ,PORTFOLIO_ID ,FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, FINPROD_ID ) temp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T1 ON temp.FINPROD_ID=T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON temp.FINPROD_ID=T2.FINPROD_ID

SELECT R1.portfolioId ,R3.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName ,R1.finprodId ,R1.finprodName ,R1.assetCost AS bonds ,R1.assetNetVal ,R1.assetCost ,R2.ptlAssetNetVal ,R2.ptlAssetCost FROM (SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId ,A.FINPROD_ID finprodId ,B.FINPROD_NAME finprodName ,nvl(A.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(A.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0) AS assetNetVal ,(CASE WHEN B.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN nvl(A.SHARE_AMT,0)*100 ELSE nvl(A.SHARE_AMT,0) END) AS assetCost FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} AND A.CDATE=TO_DATE(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'))R1 JOIN (SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, SUM(nvl(A.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(A.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) AS ptlAssetNetVal ,SUM((CASE WHEN B.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN nvl(A.SHARE_AMT,0)*100 ELSE nvl(A.SHARE_AMT,0) END)) AS ptlAssetCost FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY A.PORTFOLIO_ID,A.CDATE HAVING A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} AND A.CDATE=TO_DATE(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'))R2 ON R1.portfolioId=R2.portfolioId JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO R3 ON R1.portfolioId=R3.PORTFOLIO_ID

select * from (select PORTFOLIO_ID as id, PORTFOLIO_NAME as text from PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL
AND (TO_CHAR(VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')>=#{startDate} and #{endDate}>=TO_CHAR(VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') OR #{endDate}>=TO_CHAR(MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_CHAR(MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')>=#{startDate})
)
id like '%'||#{search}||'%' or text like '%'||#{search}||'%'

SELECT * FROM (SELECT STRATEGY_ID AS id, STRATEGY_NAME AS text FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY)
id like '%'||#{search}||'%' or text like '%'||#{search}||'%'
